usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing firewall rule on a specific VM by its zero-based position index; the caller must hold VM.Config.Network on the VM's path. To reorder a rule without changing its properties, supply only `moveto` — all other body params are ignored in that case. Pass the `digest` from a prior GET to guard against concurrent modifications overwriting each other.

examples.summary: Change rule at position 2 to DROP inbound TCP traffic on port 22 from a specific source and add a comment

tips: Rules are zero-indexed; use get_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_firewall_rules to confirm the current position before editing.
When using `moveto`, the API ignores all other body fields — issue a second PUT if you also need to change rule properties.
The `delete` param accepts a comma-separated list of field names (e.g. 'comment,log') to clear optional fields back to their defaults.
VM firewall rules are only evaluated when the VM-level firewall is enabled; check the VM firewall options if rule changes appear to have no effect.
Do not mix IPv4 and IPv6 addresses in `source` or `dest` fields — Proxmox will reject the rule.
